`skmr add` now defaults to the personal library, inside or outside a Git project.

- New remote and local skills are stored disabled, without global or project links.
- Adding an existing skill, ID, group, or imported source preserves its activation and placements.
- Use `--global` to add and enable globally, or `--project auto` / `--project <path>` to install into a project.
- The `install` alias and additions from search results follow the same default.
- README and CLI messages now explain the library-first workflow.

## Migration

If you previously used `skmr add <skill>` to install into the current project, use `skmr add <skill> --project auto`. Existing skills and project installations need no migration. `remove`, `sync`, and TUI behavior are unchanged.

## Upgrade

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade faizmokh/tap/skmr
```
